no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

response: {"headline": "CANTOS met its primary MACE endpoint in 10,061 post-MI patients with hsCRP ≥2 mg/L after 3.8 years median follow-up, demonstrating cardiovascular benefit from IL-1β inhibition, though the effect size is not quantifiable by lipid/BP surrogates and safety signals include infections.","summary": "The CANTOS trial randomized 10,061 patients with prior myocardial infarction and hsCRP ≥2 mg/L to canakinumab or placebo, with a median follow-up of 3.8 years. The trial met its primary endpoint of time to first MACE (cardiovascular death, non-fatal MI, non-fatal stroke), demonstrating that IL-1β inhibition reduces recurrent cardiovascular events. The drug reduced hsCRP by 43.2% (placebo-adjusted at 3 months) and IL-6 by 42.0% without major effects on LDL-C or HDL-C, confirming a pure anti-inflammatory mechanism.
